columns.name: identifier
columns.desc: Identifier(s) by which this encounter is known

columns.name: status
columns.desc: planned | arrived | triaged | in-progress | onleave | finished | cancelled +

columns.name: statusHistory
columns.desc: List of past encounter statuses

columns.name: statusHistory.status
columns.desc: planned | arrived | triaged | in-progress | onleave | finished | cancelled +

columns.name: statusHistory.period
columns.desc: The time that the episode was in the specified status

columns.name: class
columns.desc: Classification of patient encounter

columns.name: classHistory
columns.desc: List of past encounter classes

columns.name: classHistory.class
columns.desc: inpatient | outpatient | ambulatory | emergency +

columns.name: classHistory.period
columns.desc: The time that the episode was in the specified class

columns.name: type
columns.desc: Specific type of encounter

columns.name: serviceType
columns.desc: Specific type of service

columns.name: priority
columns.desc: Indicates the urgency of the encounter

columns.name: subject
columns.desc: The patient or group present at the encounter

columns.name: episodeOfCare
columns.desc: Episode(s) of care that this encounter should be recorded against

columns.name: basedOn
columns.desc: The ServiceRequest that initiated this encounter

columns.name: participant
columns.desc: List of participants involved in the encounter

columns.name: participant.type
columns.desc: Role of participant in encounter

columns.name: participant.period
columns.desc: Period of time during the encounter that the participant participated

columns.name: participant.individual
columns.desc: Persons involved in the encounter other than the patient

columns.name: appointment
columns.desc: The appointment that scheduled this encounter

columns.name: period
columns.desc: The start and end time of the encounter

columns.name: length
columns.desc: Quantity of time the encounter lasted (less time absent)

columns.name: reasonCode
columns.desc: Coded reason the encounter takes place

columns.name: reasonReference
columns.desc: Reason the encounter takes place (reference)

columns.name: diagnosis
columns.desc: The list of diagnosis relevant to this encounter

columns.name: diagnosis.condition
columns.desc: The diagnosis or procedure relevant to the encounter

columns.name: diagnosis.use
columns.desc: Role that this diagnosis has within the encounter (e.g. admission, billing, discharge …)

columns.name: diagnosis.rank
columns.desc: Ranking of the diagnosis (for each role type)

columns.name: account
columns.desc: The set of accounts that may be used for billing for this Encounter

columns.name: hospitalization
columns.desc: Details about the admission to a healthcare service

columns.name: hospitalization.preAdmissionIdentifier
columns.desc: Pre-admission identifier

columns.name: hospitalization.origin
columns.desc: The location/organization from which the patient came before admission

columns.name: hospitalization.admitSource
columns.desc: From where patient was admitted (physician referral, transfer)

columns.name: hospitalization.reAdmission
columns.desc: The type of hospital re-admission that has occurred (if any). If the value is absent, then this is not identified as a readmission

columns.name: hospitalization.dietPreference
columns.desc: Diet preferences reported by the patient

columns.name: hospitalization.specialCourtesy
columns.desc: Special courtesies (VIP, board member)

columns.name: hospitalization.specialArrangement
columns.desc: Wheelchair, translator, stretcher, etc.

columns.name: hospitalization.destination
columns.desc: Location/organization to which the patient is discharged

columns.name: hospitalization.dischargeDisposition
columns.desc: Category or kind of location after discharge

columns.name: location
columns.desc: List of locations where the patient has been

columns.name: location.location
columns.desc: Location the encounter takes place

columns.name: location.status
columns.desc: planned | active | reserved | completed

columns.name: location.physicalType
columns.desc: The physical type of the location (usually the level in the location hierachy - bed room ward etc.)

columns.name: location.period
columns.desc: Time period during which the patient was present at the location

columns.name: serviceProvider
columns.desc: The organization (facility) responsible for this encounter

columns.name: partOf
columns.desc: Another Encounter this encounter is part of
